The plot visualizes the relationship between the number of completions and coverage for different language models. The x-axis is labeled “Number of completions (k)” and employs a logarithmic scale, ranging from 2⁰ to 2⁸, corresponding to values of 1 to 256, with tick labels at each power of 2. The y-axis is labeled “Coverage” and utilizes a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 0.8, with tick labels at 0.2 intervals. A blue solid line with circular markers represents Llama-3B, beginning at approximately 0.42 coverage at 1 completion (2⁰) and reaching 0.49 coverage at 256 completions (2⁸). A green dashed line with triangular markers represents Llama-3B + FT, starting at approximately 0.44 coverage at 1 completion (2⁰) and ending at approximately 0.52 coverage at 256 completions (2⁸). A light blue dashed line with diamond markers represents Llama-1B, beginning at approximately 0.36 coverage at 1 completion (2⁰) and reaching 0.43 coverage at 256 completions (2⁸). A green solid line with square markers represents Llama-1B + FT, beginning at approximately 0.38 coverage at 1 completion (2⁰) and reaching 0.46 coverage at 256 completions (2⁸).
